regions.today: Mostly dry today, just a few patches of light rain early this afternoon with some more persistent light rain and drizzle later this evening. Becoming breezy as southwesterly winds strengthen moderate to fresh this evening. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees.
regions.tonight: Light rain and drizzle clearing early tonight, becoming dry overnight. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 14 degrees with fresh and gusty westerly winds easing by morning.
regions.tomorrow: Largely dry tomorrow and becoming increasingly sunny as the day progresses. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees in a light to moderate westerly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high Wednesday. High on Thursday.
